title: DaVinci IQ3 Cool Core
description:
Zirconia Cool Core™ replacement part for DaVinci IQ3 Vaporizer.

This patented technology cools vapor by 50%
compared to previous models, delivering a refreshingly cool sensation
with every draw. For an even more extraordinary experience, pre-chill the
zirconia-glass Cool Core™ in the freezer to enjoy vapor that feels almost
otherworldly.
